submissions.title: On-chain Art for All
submissions.description: On-chain Art for All—An Opportunity to Create! A school for children with disabilities serves as a space where every child—whether they are deaf, physically disabled, have Down syndrome, an intellectual disability, or are blind—can learn, express themselves, and develop their talents without limits. Support creative freedom, value every child’s work, and build an inclusive future through on-chain art. Because every child possesses potential, every creation holds value, and everyone deserves an equal opportunity to create.

submissions.title: Creative Freedom 🪽
submissions.description:
Creativity was never meant to be caged.
The bird is a folded origami piece and the B&W part of her body inside the frame represents creative restrictions. As she escapes the frame by breaking the thread/chain she was tied to, the part of her body outside the frame is shown colourful and represents creative freedom 🌈🫟
I made this craft piece with cardboard, paper, matchstick, thread and colour pens.

submissions.title: YELLOW IS EVERYWHERE
submissions.description:
We brought onchain art into the real world by placing Yellow Collective brand logo stickers around the city. More than just a visual presence, "Yellow Is Everywhere" is an initiative to spark curiosity, catch people's attention, and introduce them to the world of onchain art in unexpected places.

Yellow Collective is more than a logo. It's a presence, a movement, and a reminder that onchain culture can exist everywhere.
